## load Covariate data
```{r}
Covariates<-read_excel("../../../../../Data/Covariates/ECVGroups_Deyssenrothlab.xlsx")
parity_fgr<-read_excel("../../../../../Data/Covariates/MHS1_TCD_within.1.week.PP.xlsx",sheet="table 1 data")
IVF<-read.csv("../../../../../Data/Covariates/MFMNeuroMillerMother-HelenPregnancyCharac_DATA_LABELS_2026-10-27_1341.csv")
PE_dx<-read.csv("../../../../../Data/Covariates/MFMNeuroMillerMother-Table1_DATA_LABELS_2026-10-27_1523.csv")
BMI<-read.csv("../../../../../Data/Covariates/MFMNeuroMillerMother-BMI_DATA_LABELS_2026-10-27_1955.csv")

seqid<-read_excel("../../../../../Data/RNAseq/Genohub_3272746_Sequencing_Metrics.xlsx")
```

# find file locations of bam files
```{r bam_location}

# Function to recursively search for files with specific extensions
find_files <- function(directory, extensions) {
  files <- dir_ls(directory, recurse = TRUE)
  filtered_files <- files[str_detect(files, paste0("\\.", extensions, "$"))]
  as.character(filtered_files)
}

# path to directory
directory <- "../../../../../Data/RNAseq/STAR/STAR_align_clean"

# Replace with the directory you want to search in
extensions <- c("bam")     # Replace with the desired extensions

file_locations <- find_files(directory, extensions)
print(file_locations)

file.exists(file_locations)

#35 files
```

## reformat covariate data
```{r}
seqid<-seqid%>%
  dplyr::select(`RealSeq ID`,`Customer ID`)%>%
  dplyr::rename(seqid=`RealSeq ID`,SID= `Customer ID`)%>%
  filter(grepl("RSB",seqid))%>%
  separate(seqid,c("seqid1","seqid2"))%>%
  mutate(seqid=paste0(seqid1,"-",seqid2),
        seqid2=str_pad(seqid2,2,pad="0"),
         SID=as.character(SID),
         bam=paste0(seqid1,"-",seqid2,"Aligned.sortedByCoord.out.bam"))
  

parity_fgr<-parity_fgr%>%
  dplyr::rename(SID=studyid)%>%
  mutate(SID=as.character(SID),
         Primiparous=as.factor(ifelse(is.na(primiparous),NA,
                       ifelse(primiparous==1,"Yes","No"))),
         FGR=as.factor(ifelse(is.na(fgr),NA,
                              ifelse(fgr==0,"No","Yes"))))%>%
  dplyr::select(SID,medicaid,edu,gdm,Primiparous,FGR)
  
  
IVF<-IVF%>%
  dplyr::rename(SID=Subject.ID,IVF=`Diagnoses..Maternal..choice.IVF.`)%>%
  mutate(IVF=ifelse(IVF=="Unchecked","No","Yes"),
         SID=as.character(SID))%>%
  dplyr::select(SID,IVF)


severe_cols <- c(
  "Cerebral.symptoms", 
  "Pulmonary.edema",
  "Platelets...100K",
  "Serum.transaminase...2x.upper.limit",
  "Severe.epigastric.or.right.upper.quadrant.pain",
  "Progressive.renal.insufficiency", 
  "Eclampsia"
)
PE_dx<-PE_dx%>%
  dplyr::rename(SID=Subject.ID)%>%
  rename_with(
    ~ str_replace(.x, "Severe\\.features\\.\\.choice\\.(.*?)\\.?$", "\\1"),
    starts_with("Severe.features..choice."))%>%
  mutate(organ_dysfunction=ifelse(
      if_any(all_of(severe_cols), ~ .x %in% "Checked"), 
      "Yes", 
      "No"),
      Antihyp_rx=ifelse(
      if_any(starts_with("Antihypertensive.medications"), ~ .x %in% "Checked"), 
      "Yes", 
      "No"),
      Proteinuria=ifelse(is.na(Proteinuria),NA,
                         ifelse(Proteinuria=="Checked","Yes","No")),
      SID=as.character(SID))%>%
  dplyr::select(SID,organ_dysfunction,Proteinuria,Antihyp_rx)

BMI<-BMI%>%
  dplyr::rename(SID=Subject.ID)%>%
  dplyr::select(SID,BMI)

Covariates%>%
  group_by(Ethnicity, Race)%>%
  summarise(n=n())%>%
  spread(Race, n)

Covariates<-Covariates%>%
  mutate(SID=as.character(SID))%>%
  left_join(parity_fgr, by="SID")%>%
  left_join(IVF, by="SID")%>%
  left_join(PE_dx,by="SID")%>%
  left_join(BMI,by="SID")%>%
  mutate(Group=ifelse(`Participant Group`=="Control","Normotensive","Preeclampsia"),
         blood_collect=as.Date(`Maternal Blood Collection Time`),
         delivery_date=as.Date(`Date of Delivery`),
         Collection_interval=difftime(ymd(blood_collect),ymd(delivery_date),units="days"),
         Collection_interval=as.numeric(str_remove(Collection_interval," days")),
         delivery_mode=as.factor(`Delivery mode`),
         BMI_cat=as.factor(`Delivery BMI categorical`),
         Race.ethnicity=factor(ifelse(Ethnicity=="NOT Hispanic"&Race=="White"|Ethnicity=="NOT hispanic"&Race=="White","Non-Hispanic White",
                               ifelse(Ethnicity=="NOT Hispanic"&Race=="Black or African American","Black",
                                      ifelse(Ethnicity=="Hispanic","Hispanic",
                                             ifelse(Race=="Unknown",NA,"Other"))))),
         Race.ethnicity=fct_relevel(Race.ethnicity,c("Non-Hispanic White","Hispanic","Black","Other")),
         Edu=factor(ifelse(edu<3,"Less than High School",
                           ifelse(edu==3,"High School",
                                  ifelse(edu>3&edu<6,"Some college",
                                         ifelse(edu>=6,"College",NA))))),
         Insurance=factor(ifelse(is.na(medicaid),NA,
                                       ifelse(medicaid==1,"Public","Private"))),
         Group=as.factor(Group),
         Headache=as.factor(Headache),
         combined_group=factor(paste0(Group,"_",Headache)))%>%
  dplyr::rename(Gest.age=`Weeks at delivery`)%>%
  dplyr::select(SID,Group,Headache,combined_group,organ_dysfunction,Proteinuria,Antihyp_rx,Collection_interval,BMI_cat,BMI,Primiparous,IVF,delivery_mode,Gest.age,FGR,Race.ethnicity,Edu,Insurance)

Covariates<-Covariates%>%
  right_join(seqid %>% dplyr::select(SID,seqid,bam))
  

Covariates<-Covariates[match(basename(file_locations),Covariates$bam),]

table(Covariates$combined_group,Covariates$Antihyp_rx)
table(Covariates$combined_group,Covariates$Edu)
table(Covariates$combined_group,Covariates$Insurance)


```


## demotable
```{r demo}
demo_preeclampsia<-Covariates%>%
  dplyr::select(-c(SID,seqid,bam,combined_group,Headache))%>%
tbl_summary(
    by = Group,
    statistic = list(all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
                     all_categorical() ~ "{n}    ({p}%)"),
    digits = list(all_continuous()  ~ c(2, 2),
                  all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)),
    type = list(Collection_interval ~ "continuous",
                organ_dysfunction ~ "categorical",
                Proteinuria ~ "categorical",
                Antihyp_rx ~ "categorical",
                BMI ~ "continuous",
                Primiparous ~ "categorical",
                IVF ~ "categorical",
                Race.ethnicity ~ "categorical",
                delivery_mode ~ "categorical",
                Gest.age ~ "continuous",
                FGR ~ "categorical"),
    label  = list(Collection_interval ~ "Time to collection (days)",
                organ_dysfunction ~ "Organ dysfunction",
                Antihyp_rx ~ "Anti-hypertensive Rx",
                BMI ~ "BMI at Delivery",
                Race.ethnicity ~ "Race/ethnicity",
                delivery_mode ~ "Delivery Mode",
                Gest.age ~ "Gestational age (weeks)")
  ) %>%
  add_p(pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 2)) %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Variable**",
                all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**<br>N = {n} ({style_percent(p, digits=1)}%)") %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_caption("<div style='text-align: left; font-weight: bold;'> Participant characteristics by Preeclampsia status</div>")

knitr::knit_print(demo_preeclampsia)


demo_headache<-Covariates%>%
  dplyr::select(-c(SID,seqid,bam,Headache,Group))%>%
tbl_summary(
    by = combined_group,
    statistic = list(all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
                     all_categorical() ~ "{n}    ({p}%)"),
    digits = list(all_continuous()  ~ c(2, 2),
                  all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)),
    type = list(Collection_interval ~ "continuous",
                organ_dysfunction ~ "categorical",
                Proteinuria ~ "categorical",
                Antihyp_rx ~ "categorical",
                BMI ~ "continuous",
                Primiparous ~ "categorical",
                IVF ~ "categorical",
                Race.ethnicity ~ "categorical",
                delivery_mode ~ "categorical",
                Gest.age ~ "continuous",
                FGR ~ "categorical"),
    label  = list(Collection_interval ~ "Time to collection (days)",
                organ_dysfunction ~ "Organ dysfunction",
                Antihyp_rx ~ "Anti-hypertensive Rx",
                BMI ~ "BMI at Delivery",
                Race.ethnicity ~ "Race/ethnicity",
                delivery_mode ~ "Delivery Mode",
                Gest.age ~ "Gestational age (weeks)")
  ) %>%
  add_p(pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 2)) %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Variable**",
                all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**<br>N = {n} ({style_percent(p, digits=1)}%)") %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_caption("<div style='text-align: left; font-weight: bold;'> Participant characteristics by Preeclampsia and Headache status</div>")

knitr::knit_print(demo_headache)


```
